Lorsque l’envoi est configuré, le naviga: When sending is configured, your browser submits the form to the website’s server. After validation and spam checks, the server sends the enquiry to Resend, the email delivery provider, for forwarding to the inbox configured for LEA. Si le service n’est pas configuré, le fo: If the service is not configured, the form shows that sending is unavailable and does not allow submission. The contact details entered then remain on the page in your browser. In previews using test mode, the server simulates acceptance without sending an email, and the website makes this explicit.
Le serveur vérifie les champs, l’origine: The server checks the fields, request origin and size, an anti-bot field and a minimum completion time. It limits the number of requests within a ten-minute window. In production, a technical identifier derived from the IP address using a secret key is used for counting in configured Redis storage. The raw IP address is not recorded in that storage. Counters expire after ten minutes.
En développement local, ce comptage est: During local development, this count is temporarily held in the server’s memory. The application code does not log the form’s content or your contact details and does not create a database of enquiries.

Les personnes habilitées à consulter la: People authorised to access LEA’s inbox and the configured service providers may process the information needed for their roles. Le site n’intègre pas d’outil publicitai: The website does not include advertising or audience analytics tools. No Instagram content or third-party cookies are loaded by default. Images and fonts are served from the website. In the before/after gallery, the “Show post” button loads Meta’s Instagram viewer. This service may then receive your IP address and use its own cookies. The administration area uses two technical cookies for its session only: lea_admin for authentication and lea_preview for the private preview, for a maximum of eight hours. Contact forms are not recorded in this database. The operator still needs to specify the retention arrangements for this management data.
